name: Mizuhara Karin
source:
She is a genuine young lady with the blood of one of the most prominent aristocratic families in the country.

She is the youngest of four children, with two older brothers and an older sister. She was raised to be introverted, but she is interested in the arts and writes poetry and novels.

She admires Erika, who has a glamorous image, and Rui, who is more active, as her seniors, and is often looked up to by them.

She is a member of the Literature and Art Club. She has a taste for gothic lolita fashion.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/onihei2/index.html]official site[/url]]
